allowed_ablations.name: no-sweep
allowed_ablations.removed: sweep requirement: reference touch + reclaim close suffices

hypotheses.deduplication_rule: One open position per symbol; signals while in position are ignored; repeated bars of one sweep reference count as one economic idea.
hypotheses.direction_rule: Reclaim direction: sweep of lows reclaimed upward -> BULLISH; sweep of highs reclaimed downward -> BEARISH.
hypotheses.entry_condition: Sweep bar i (wick beyond reference, close back inside) with reference from the frozen hierarchy, ATR available.
hypotheses.entry_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (market fill at bar i+1 open; no same-bar lookahead)
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Market entry always fills at next open; position exits only via structural stop/target (no time expiry).

hypotheses.research_question: Does a confirmed sweep of a previously established liquidity reference followed by a causal reclaim produce directional edge?
hypotheses.risk_rule: Certified sizing: balance 2000, risk/trade 0.01, leverage 10, allocation cap 500 (unchanged).
hypotheses.scientific_claim: A sweep bar that wicks beyond a frozen-hierarchy liquidity reference and closes back inside, entered next-bar-open with stop beyond the sweep extreme plus 0.25 ATR and fixed 2.0R target, exhibits positive OOS expectancy after Cost C.
hypotheses.target_rule: Fixed 2.0R from entry (frozen; no RR mining).

allowed_ablations.name: no-displacement
allowed_ablations.removed: displacement requirement: sweep + reclaim alone qualifies

hypotheses.deduplication_rule: One open position per symbol; same as H11G-001.
hypotheses.direction_rule: Displacement-bar direction (close >= open -> BULLISH, else BEARISH); must match sweep side.
hypotheses.entry_condition: Sweep within the 3 bars ending at displacement bar j (inclusive) on the same side, then displacement (range > 2x ATR14) at j.
hypotheses.entry_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (market fill at bar j+1 open)
hypotheses.name: Sweep + Displacement
hypotheses.research_question: Does a liquidity sweep followed by confirmed displacement produce better directional expectancy than the sweep event alone?
hypotheses.scientific_claim: A same-side sweep within 3 bars of a 2xATR displacement bar, entered next-bar-open with stop beyond the displacement extreme plus 0.25 ATR and fixed 2.0R target, exhibits positive OOS expectancy after Cost C.

hypotheses.deduplication_rule: One open position per symbol; one pending FVG retest per direction at a time.
hypotheses.direction_rule: Displacement-bar direction; FVG must agree in direction.
hypotheses.entry_condition: Sweep + displacement (H11G-002 conditions) forming an FVG on the displacement bar; subsequent touch of the FVG edge within 5 bars (retest bar i, never the setup bar itself).
hypotheses.entry_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (market fill at bar i+1 open following the retest-touch bar; no same-bar lookahead, no limit-fill assumption)
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Pending retest expires after 5 bars; live positions exit via structural stop/target.
hypotheses.name: Sweep + Displacement + FVG Retest
hypotheses.research_question: Does adding a causally confirmed FVG/retest condition to sweep + displacement improve economic performance?
hypotheses.scientific_claim: Sweep + displacement with same-bar FVG, entered next-bar-open after an FVG-edge retest within 5 bars (stop beyond FVG far edge + 0.25 ATR, fixed 2.0R), exhibits positive OOS expectancy after Cost C.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Beyond FVG far edge + 0.25x ATR14 buffer.

allowed_ablations.name: no-bos
allowed_ablations.removed: BOS requirement: order block before any displacement bar qualifies

hypotheses.deduplication_rule: One open position per symbol; one pending OB retest per direction at a time.
hypotheses.direction_rule: BOS direction (bullish break -> BULLISH OB long; bearish break -> BEARISH OB short).
hypotheses.entry_condition: Confirmed BOS bar c (close beyond most-recent confirmed opposite swing extreme); qualifying OB = last opposite-range candle strictly before c; subsequent touch of the OB edge within 5 bars (retest bar i).
hypotheses.entry_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (market fill at bar i+1 open following the retest-touch bar)
hypotheses.expiry_rule: Pending retest expires after 5 bars; live positions exit via structural stop/target.
hypotheses.name: Order Block after BOS + Retest
hypotheses.research_question: Does a causally identified order block formed in connection with confirmed BOS produce robust edge on retest?
hypotheses.scientific_claim: A BOS bar with a strictly-prior opposite-candle order block, retested at the OB edge within 5 bars and entered next-bar-open (stop beyond OB far extreme + 0.25 ATR, fixed 2.0R), exhibits positive OOS expectancy after Cost C.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Beyond OB far extreme + 0.25x ATR14 buffer.

hypotheses.expiry_rule: Pending retest expires after 5 bars; live positions exit via structural stop/target.

hypotheses.scientific_claim: A close crossing back through a confirmed swing level, retested within 5 bars and entered next-bar-open (stop beyond level + 0.25 ATR, fixed 2.0R), exhibits positive OOS expectancy after Cost C.
